name: MCIPCD5
tagline: Intel N100 / i3-N305 industrial PC with two cooling options
description: Choose standard fanless MCIPCD5 or optional fan-equipped MCIPCD5F. Both share Intel N100 / i3-N305, DDR5 up to 32 GB, four Intel I226-V interfaces and dual COM. The complete table distinguishes internal headers, optional TPM 2.0 and the installed fan.

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 1 x DDR5-4800 SO-DIMM, up to 32 GB

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 2 x HDMI 2.0, up to 4K/60 Hz; internal eDP header, up to 1080p/60 Hz

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x SATA 3.0 (6 Gb/s); 1 x M.2 2280 with SATA / PCIe auto-switching

specs.label: Network
specs.value: 4 x Intel I226-V RJ45; LAN1 may use an internal pin header

specs.label: USB
specs.value: 4 x USB 2.0 (header option) + 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 2

specs.label: Serial
specs.value: 2 x RS-232 COM; COM2 supports RS-485; COM1 RJ45 option

specs.label: BIOS
specs.value: AMI 128 Mb; Auto Power On; PXE; Wake-on-LAN

specs.label: Configuration notes
specs.value: Electrical specifications are shared; installed fan and enclosure appearance follow the selected option. Images are for reference; final I/O follows the confirmed configuration.

advantageSummary: Match the platform, memory, storage and interfaces to the confirmed configuration.
